B0.cold_start: trivially defined; no subject-level history needed
B0.formula: yhat = mean(epa) over all plays of this class with ordinal < forecast ordinal
B0.information_set: every prior play of this class, both seasons
B0.name: league constant

B1.cold_start: a club absent from the prior season falls back to B0
B1.formula: yhat = mu_hist + rho*(off_prev[o] + def_prev[d]), where off_prev and def_prev are prior-SEASON mean residuals per unit and rho is offseason regression
B1.information_set: the complete prior season only; no current-season play is read
B1.name: prior-season unit prior

B2.cold_start: spills into the prior season, then B1, then B0
B2.formula: yhat = mu_hist + rbar(o, n) + rbar(d, n), rbar the mean residual over the unit`s last n games
B2.information_set: current season to date, spilling into the prior season when fewer than n games exist
B2.name: rolling unit mean

B3.formula: as B2 with exponentially weighted residuals at the tuned half-life, weight 0.5 ** (games_back / half_life)
B3.name: EWMA unit mean

B4.cold_start: a unit with no prior plays falls back to B1, then B0
B4.formula: iterative subtraction: off[o] <- mean residual of o`s plays minus the mean def of the opponents faced; def[d] symmetrically; iterated to B4_TOL or B4_MAX_ITER. No penalty, no matrix inversion
B4.hyperparameters: none. Declared with `n_passes` and measured out of existence: undamped Jacobi oscillates with period 2 on an unidentified design, so a pass count selects between two arbitrary answers. It iterates to B4_TOL and reports convergence
B4.name: simple opponent-adjusted
B4.non_convergence: falls back to the SINGLE-PASS estimate, which is the declared definition -- unit mean minus the mean of the opponents faced -- and is the only pass with a defensible reading. Recorded as converged=False, never silently
B4.tuning_rule: not applicable; convergence is not a hyperparameter

B5.formula: yhat = mu_hist + blend(o) + blend(d), blend(u) = kappa*B4(u) + (1-kappa)*rho*B1_prev(u)
B5.name: shrunken opponent-adjusted -- THE DECISIVE COMPARATOR
B5.tuning_rule: forward-chained, one-SE, most-shrunken = smallest kappa then smallest rho

tie_break: among configurations within one standard error of the best mean score, take the most shrunken, using SHRINK_DIRECTION per hyperparameter in the order the grid declares them
why_2024_not_scored: it supplies history only. A 2024 fold would have no prior season, so B1 and B5 would fall back to B0 for every club and the comparison would be between four estimators, not six.
